name: Facet
text: Choose a dark theme by default with a one-click toggle to light mode. It reduces eye strain in low-light settings and keeps the interface clean, matching the Manus Competitive Analysis and Graphify Dashboard. The trade-off is that users in bright environments may need to manually switch, but most data work happens in controlled lighting where dark mode shines.

name: Pane
text: Dark mode hides errors when contrast drops—like Manus’s analysis warns. Light mode by default still risks users missing errors in glare—like Manus’s dashboard. The real risk is inconsistent error visibility across environments. Settle it with A/B testing: measure error detection rates in both modes under controlled lighting conditions.
